question: Can supported external GPU profilers corroborate the v1 block-cycle diagnosis on the exact recorded query prefixes?

claims.text: Both unprofiled transcript replays match v1 responses exactly; external profiler outcomes are retained verbatim.
External counter/timeline attribution is diagnostic only; no cross-host timing or speedup claim.

arms.description: Nsight Compute first matching search launch

aa.not_applicable_reason: Only descriptive profiler attribution; no performance comparison. Prior v1 retains five rounds of A/A event-time controls.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Provider GPU control kernel through tools/profile.sh probe; v1 315 exact query cases and37584 arithmetic cases already passed on unchanged source.

negative.not_applicable_reason: V1 retained54 exhausted misses and three zero-error sanitizers on unchanged source; this supplement does not modify the query implementation.

seed_derivation.note: Exactly101/202, existing63-bit input files copied unchanged; driver RNG unchanged.

blinding.how: Descriptive instrumentation, not inferential analysis; labels not masked.

power.note: Exact response checks and descriptive profiler outcomes; no statistical hypothesis test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: V1 ran in about4.5minutes including setup. Supplement builds onlystockservice; each externalprofiler capped600s, totalworker3600/controller3900s.

primary.name: Exact unprofiled replies
primary.definition: Eight for baseline iff complete stdout equals v1 answers; external tools have no new recovery claim.

record: Native profiler manifests and raw reports
All exits including unsupported and timeout
Package versions, source and GPU identity

stopping_rules.rule: Oneprobe and two fixed inputs, eachbaseline/nsys/ncu once; no repeats or panelrerun. Worker3600/controller3900seconds, eachtool600seconds. Deleteownedpodaftercollection.

invalidation_rules: An unprofiled response mismatch invalidates source/input continuity. Failed or unsupported externalprofiler attempts remain reported with exit/reason; no counters invented.

decision_rule.text: Report baseline reply identity and native external-profiler statuses. Interpret instruction/stall/occupancy/source evidence only if actually collected. Preserve v1 setup failures and cycle data unchanged.
decision_rule.threshold: Two exact baseline replies; allsix attempts accounted for unless preflight fails
decision_rule.statistic: Exact checks and native profiler counters

graphs: Native supported kernel/memory/stall plots; v1 graph retained if no supported counters

inadmissible: Calling prefix execution a complete recovery
Converting concurrent block-cycle totals or shares into production seconds
Treating instrumented kernel time as a throughput or speedup result
Silently skipping failed cells or counter permission failures

literature.claim: Large affine runs are dominated by query oracle; arithmetic count omits conversion normalization and index memory costs.
Per-SM cycle intervals include time slicing; they are not instruction execution cost.
Replay/cache controls and metric collection perturb kernels; source counters and occupancy can explain costs if supported.
